name: kartograph
description: Record a conversation with a person, derive their intent from it, and map that intent against what the project already has, all in one kartograph/ bundle; extract its concepts into an Open Knowledge Format bundle at knowledge/, derive capabilities and Gherkin features under features/, plan the implementation in three hexagonal rings for the project's technology stack, build the screens on sample data, then the domain, then the adapters, and walk the person through what was built.

interface.shortDescription: Draw out what a person really wants before anything gets built
interface.longDescription: Kartograph has twelve skills that build on each other through plain files. kartograph-converse runs one conversation with you and records it in kartograph/<date>-<slug>.conversation.md. kartograph-intent derives your goals, outcomes, non-goals, constraints and decisions from it into kartograph/<date>-<slug>.intent.md. kartograph-map holds that intent against features/ and the git history in kartograph/<date>-<slug>.mapping.md: done, partly done, new, or contradicts. kartograph-knowledge records every concept a mapped intent introduces in an Open Knowledge Format bundle at knowledge/. kartograph-features derives capabilities and Gherkin features under features/. kartograph-plan detects the project's technology stack (Kotlin Multiplatform today; more stacks are directories) and writes a three-ring plan: screens, domain, adapters. kartograph-screens builds ring 1 on fakes with sample data so you can walk the flow first; kartograph-domain builds the real behaviour with a test per scenario; kartograph-adapters builds repositories, database, API client, platform capabilities and the server. kartograph-walk drives the running app scenario by scenario in front of you after any ring and records your verdicts under walks/. kartograph-deliver gets what was built into a person's hands: locally, on a device, on the test tracks, or in the stores. kartograph-migrate brings a project's kartograph/ files onto the plugin's current layout in one commit.
defaultPrompt: Talk through a new feature with kartograph-converse
Plan the project-archiving capability with kartograph-plan
Build the screens for the newest plan with kartograph-screens
Walk me through the project-archiving capability with kartograph-walk
